lanka_shankari.name: Shankari / Koneswaram
lanka_shankari.architecture: The present Dravidian Koneswaram complex stands on a narrow sea cliff. Its modern buildings are distinct from the ancient temple destroyed in the Portuguese period; the lost original Shankari footprint remains unresolved.
lanka_shankari.deity_notes: Do not invent an exact ancient Shankari murti from a generic Parvati image. Present Mathumai Amman and the lost historical Shankari shrine require explicit identification.
lanka_shankari.uncertainties: No authenticated main-murti photo selected; current temple and historical reconstruction remain separate.

kanchipuram_kamakshi.name: Kamakshi Amman

kanchipuram_kamakshi.attributes: Sugarcane bow; lotus/parrot; pasha and ankusha. Published accounts vary on hand assignment.
kanchipuram_kamakshi.deity_notes: Do not use a standing four-armed generic Devi. Label processional images separately from the seated main murti.
kanchipuram_kamakshi.uncertainties: Exact finger/hand geometry must be checked against an authenticated main-murti view. The official page image inspected was an exterior, so it was not substituted for a murti portrait.

alampur_jogulamba.name: Jogulamba

draksharama_manikyamba.name: Manikyamba / Bhimeswara

Two stairways access the upper sanctum around the tall Bhimeswara linga; Manikyamba occupies the northern inner gallery. The other named shrine groups occupy their documented eastern, southern and western galleries.

kamakhya.name: Kamarupa / Kamakhya

kamakhya.attributes: Natural cleft, spring water and ritual coverings
kamakhya.deity_notes: Do not replace the main cave sacred form with a generic multi-armed Devi. Keep movable Kameshwari images distinct from the main sacred formation.
kamakhya.uncertainties: No authenticated cave close-up selected; exact access, water and coverings need separate evidence.
